1. Agreement

These Terms of Use are an agreement between you and Believe PR, owned by Armando Jimenez ("we", "us"), about the Better Tomorrow app. By downloading or using the app, you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use the app.

Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle personal information. The terms of the App Store or Google Play also apply to how you get the app and buy subscriptions.

2. Who can use Better Tomorrow

You must be at least 13 years old, or older if your country requires it, to use the app. If you are under 18, you need a parent's or guardian's permission.

3. What Better Tomorrow is, and isn't

Better Tomorrow is a mood tracker and journal for self-reflection. It helps you notice patterns in how you feel.

Better Tomorrow is not a medical device and does not provide therapy, diagnosis, treatment, or crisis support. Nothing in the app is medical advice. If you are in danger or thinking about hurting yourself, contact your local emergency number or find a helpline at findahelpline.com.

4. AI-generated content

Weekly insights and affirmations are written by third-party AI models from the data you choose to send. They can be inaccurate, incomplete, or not right for you. Read them as reflections, not as facts or professional advice, and use your own judgment.

To keep the service fair and available, AI features have usage limits, may be unavailable at times, and may use different model providers over time. If a request contains words suggesting you may be in danger, the app doesn't send it and shows support resources instead.

5. Your content

Your entries, notes, photos, and voice memos belong to you. They are stored on your device, so you are responsible for keeping backups. When you use an AI feature, you allow us and our providers to process the data in that request only to create your reply.

Please don't add other people's private information to a request unless you have the right to share it.

7. Better Tomorrow Plus

Better Tomorrow Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly through your Apple Account or Google Play account.

  • The price, in your local currency, is shown in the app before you buy.
  • Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends.
  • Some plans include a free trial or an introductory offer. If you don't cancel before it ends, the paid subscription starts and you are charged.
  • Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store or Google Play account settings. Deleting the app does not cancel it.
  • If you cancel, Plus stays active until the end of the period you paid for.
  • You can restore a purchase on another device that uses the same store account.

Plus features may change over time as the app evolves.

8. Refunds

Payments are handled by Apple or Google, and refunds follow their policies: Apple or Google Play. Nothing in these terms limits refund or withdrawal rights you have by law.

9. Ads in the free version

The free version offers optional rewarded ads from Google AdMob. You receive the reward after the ad finishes. Ads come from third parties, and we don't control or endorse what they advertise.

10. Third-party services

The app relies on services from Apple, Google (Firebase, AdMob, and Google Play), RevenueCat, Cloudflare, OpenRouter and its AI providers, and Unsplash. Their own terms apply to their services. Photos from Unsplash are used under the Unsplash License, and the app credits each photographer.

11. Changes and availability

We may update, change, or stop offering features or the app itself. Some features, such as AI, purchases, ads, and Unsplash photos, need an internet connection. Because your journal lives on your device, we can't recover it if it is lost, so please keep backups.

You can stop using Better Tomorrow at any time by deleting the app. We may suspend access to online features, such as AI, if you break these terms. Sections that by their nature should continue, such as disclaimers and limits of liability, stay in effect.
